name: actionboard-v5-agentformation
description: Single-plugin marketplace for ActionBoard-V5-AgentFormation: mission-style multi-agent orchestration with a Black planner agent and four specialist agents (Red/Blue/Green/Yellow).

plugins.name: actionboard-v5-agentformation
plugins.description: Turn one objective into a reviewed plan, then execute it with five parallel agents that never touch the same file. Nothing runs until you approve. Actions are risk-classified and gated on scored run history, so nothing executes autonomously until it has proven it can. Each agent can run in a kernel-isolated OpenShell sandbox with deny-all egress and a policy audit trail. Briefs, plans, and reports export as Markdown plus schema.org JSON-LD, so a directory of missions becomes a queryable history.
